title: Scalar-adjunction transpose of a compact-support mixed-coefficient map
statement:
Fix a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$, and let $f:X\to Y$ have a compactification $X\xrightarrow j\overline X\xrightarrow hY$, with all three schemes separated of finite type over $k$, $j$ open and $h$ proper. Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$. Use the ordinary uncompleted constant-ring module derived categories on small pro-etale sites; put $F_{f,R}=Rh_{*,R}j_{!,R}$ for $R=A,B$. Write $T_Z=-\otimes^L_{A_Z}B_Z$ and $\operatorname{Res}_Z$ for the derived extension/exact restriction adjunction, with counit $\epsilon_Z:T_Z\operatorname{Res}_Z\to1$. Let $K\in\Dctf(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ and $L\in\Dctf(X_{\mathrm{proet}},B)$, meaning bounded intrinsically constructible complexes of finite Tor amplitude, and let $t:K\to\operatorname{Res}_XL$ be any derived morphism. Write $t^\sharp:T_XK\to L$ for its scalar-adjunction transpose. Use the canonical comparison $d_f:F_{f,A}\operatorname{Res}_X\simeq\operatorname{Res}_YF_{f,B}$ from [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars] and the counit-normalized $b_f:T_YF_{f,A}\to F_{f,B}T_X$ of [det-sp-reduction-direct-image]. Then
$$\bigl(d_f(L)\circ F_{f,A}(t)\bigr)^\sharp=F_{f,B}(t^\sharp)\circ b_f(K).$$
Equivalently, the scalar-extension mate of $d_f$ has the specified proper-counit and open-tensor normalization $b_f$, including its counit equation
$$\epsilon_Y(F_{f,B}L)\circ T_Y(d_f(L))=F_{f,B}(\epsilon_X(L))\circ b_f(\operatorname{Res}_XL).$$
In this last formula $b_f$ denotes the same counit-defined transformation on the ambient derived categories; invertibility is required only on $\Dctf$ input. The equality is natural in $K,L,t$, requires no flatness of $B$ over $A$, and is compatible with two successive coefficient homomorphisms and their tensor associators. An identity coefficient homomorphism gives the original map $F_{f,A}(t)$; when $t$ is also the identity the resulting map is the identity.
